note: Golden cases. status 'proposed' is NOT asserted; only 'confirmed' cases run. Expected values are derived by tests/golden/derive_expected.py from raw payloads via independent.py, never from ask() output.

cases.title: sug2rfree's map record
cases.regression: displays the in-game name, not the FACEIT nickname (KSAA0 class)
cases.question: sug2rfree record
cases.derivation: Every round in the golden stats payloads where player 58239fd5 appears: 21 maps over 5 series; a map is won when round_stats.Winner is his team id. Name is his in-game name (game_player_name), not the FACEIT nickname sug2rfree.

cases.question: sug2rfree record
cases.derivation: All 21 of his maps are in NA competitions, and the golden set includes 2 EMEA 'SpaceStation' matches (a different team) that must not appear. A wrong SpaceStation/SpaceStation Gaming merge would add them.

cases.title: ZSS's map record
cases.question: ZSS record
cases.derivation: Same derivation: 17 maps over 5 series. FACEIT nickname is z_ow; in-game name zss.

cases.question: ZSS record
cases.derivation: All maps are NA. The golden set includes both Geekay Esports teams (NA and EMEA, identical names); a wrong merge of them would pull in EMEA maps.

cases.question: Quartz03 record

cases.title: Twisted Minds' record, all seasons, byes excluded
cases.regression: bye: a bracket bye counted as a 1-0 win
cases.question: Twisted Minds record
cases.derivation: Series where Twisted Minds is a faction and the opponent is a real team: 4 (the golden set also holds a TM-vs-'bye' bracket slot, which is not a series and must not be counted as a 5th). map_wins/losses are series scores; 'maps' counts rounds that have stats, 16 (of which 5 are 1-a823bbde's, Stage 2 map results from Liquipedia rather than a FACEIT stats payload); 1 of the series still has no FACEIT stats payload of its own.

cases.title: Twisted Minds 2026, one series enriched from Liquipedia instead of FACEIT
cases.regression: result-only series counted at series grain only; then, after Stage 2, its Liquipedia maps must count at map grain and the limitation must drop once nothing in the slice is missing them
cases.question: Twisted Minds record in 2026
cases.derivation: 2 series in 2026, one of them (1) with no FACEIT stats payload: it still counts at series grain (wins and map_wins/losses from the series score), but as of Stage 2 it also contributes its 5 maps to 'maps' - from Liquipedia's match2games (1-a823bbde), not from a FACEIT stats payload. offline_map_stats no longer applies to this slice, because nothing in it is left without map results.

cases.question: SpaceStation Gaming record
cases.derivation: 5 NA series. The golden set also holds two 2024 EMEA series of 'SpaceStation' (team a359db61), which are a different team and must not be added.

cases.title: Twisted Minds vs Ex Oblivione, series grain
cases.regression: date-bounded team-to-org mapping (Stage 3): 'Ex Oblivione' is searchable as the team id's own 2024 era, and a hit on it never puts those series into Virtus pro's record
cases.question: Twisted Minds series record against Ex Oblivione
cases.derivation: 2 series between the two team ids in the golden set (both 3-1 to Twisted Minds). Team id bb5dd404 was 'Ex Oblivione' in 2024 and was later acquired into Virtus pro. The name must be searchable and find those 2024 series, which are Ex Oblivione's, not Virtus pro's.

cases.title: 'SSG' resolves to SpaceStation Gaming
cases.regression: alias: SSG did not resolve to SpaceStation Gaming
cases.question: SSG record
cases.derivation: Same numbers as G10, reached through the shorthand. Expectation is the community meaning of SSG.

cases.title: 'VP' resolves to Virtus pro; its record excludes the Ex Oblivione era
cases.regression: alias/org: VP resolves to the merged Virtus pro org; date-bounded team-to-org mapping (Stage 3): bb5dd404 is Virtus pro from 2025-01-01 only, so its Ex Oblivione era (3 series) stays out of the record
cases.question: VP record
cases.derivation: The org Virtus pro holds two team ids, c02a9899 (2026) and bb5dd404. FACEIT named bb5dd404 'Ex Oblivione' in 2024 and 'Virtuspro' in 2025. Virtus pro acquired the Ex Oblivione roster, and roster movement is not org identity, so the 3 Ex Oblivione-era series are NOT Virtus pro's: 2 series remain, 2 won, series score 7-4.

cases.question: VP record
cases.derivation: The alias vp -> org virtus-pro (scope/alias_decisions.json). Asserts only who the question resolved to, so the alias stays covered while G13's record is a known bug.

cases.title: A refusal that offers a question that works
cases.regression: a refusal with advice but no working alternative
cases.question: who had the most final blows in 2024

alternative.question_template: who had the most final blows in {season}

cases.derivation: Final Blows appears in the golden stats only for seasons [2025, 2026], not 2024, so 2024 cannot be answered. The refusal must offer the same question in a season that has the stat, and that question must answer with the top player derived independently for that season.

cases.title: Twisted Minds vs Geekay Esports (EMEA), map grain, after Stage 2 enrichment
cases.regression: Stage 2: a result_only series' Liquipedia maps must appear at map grain once enriched
cases.question: Twisted Minds map record against 46f8e560-76fe-4b5f-85e7-397957e0dc74
cases.derivation: Two series between these team ids: 1-a106c5a1 (3 real FACEIT maps, all Twisted Minds) and 1-a823bbde (result_only on FACEIT, 5 maps from Liquipedia's own match2games: Geekay win Oasis and Circuit Royal, Twisted Minds win King's Row, Runasapi and Suravasa). Combined: 8 maps, 6-2 to Twisted Minds, over 2 series. Before Stage 2 this was 3-0 over 1 series' worth of maps (the second series contributed nothing to map grain).

cases.title: A player on the enriched match still has no player stats from it
cases.regression: Stage 2: a Liquipedia-sourced map must never produce a player row
cases.question: SimpleOW record
cases.derivation: SimpleOW played on Geekay Esports (EMEA) in both 1-a106c5a1 (3 real FACEIT maps) and 1-a823bbde (the enriched result_only series, 5 of its maps now visible at team grain via G27). FACEIT's own stats payload for the enriched series carries no players at all - Liquipedia never has player stats to add - so his independently-derived record is exactly the 3 maps of 1-a106c5a1: Stage 2 must not have created a match_players row for the enriched match.

cases.title: Twisted Minds in 2025: only a bye, so no data
cases.regression: bye: a 2025 bye showed as a 1-0 win
cases.question: Twisted Minds record in 2025
cases.derivation: The only 2025 Twisted Minds fixture is the bracket bye, which is not a series: the answer is no_data, not '1-0'. The offered alternative (the all-seasons record) must answer with G08's numbers.

cases.title: A question in the displayed OWCS name resolves: Stage 2 Regular Season, not Stage 1
cases.regression: the displayed competition name was not searchable (matching used only FACEIT's stored name), and the parser kept only one phrase of the competition name
cases.question: SpaceStation Gaming record in OWCS 2026 NA Stage 2 Regular Season
cases.derivation: 'OWCS 2026 NA Stage 2 Regular Season' is FACEIT's 'S9 NA OWCS Central - Regular Season' (S9 = 2026 Stage 2 per scope/liquipedia_map.json). SpaceStation Gaming played 1 series there (1-0, maps 3-0) and 1 in Stage 1's regular season, which must not be counted.

cases.title: A question in the displayed OWCS name resolves: Stage 2 Playoffs, not the regular season
cases.regression: the displayed competition name was not searchable
cases.question: Dallas Fuel record in OWCS 2026 NA Stage 2 Playoffs
cases.derivation: 'OWCS 2026 NA Stage 2 Playoffs' is FACEIT's 'S9 NA OWCS Central - Playoffs'. Dallas Fuel played 2 series there (2-0, maps 7-2); its 1 regular-season series (0-1) is the same stage and must not be counted.

cases.title: A player-stat question for a results-only region is refused for that reason, with a working alternative
cases.regression: Stage 3 step 4: capability, not just coverage
cases.question: who had the most eliminations in korea
cases.derivation: Korea is declared a results-only region (region_sources: Liquipedia only, no player stats) before any of its data exists, and no golden series is in that region. A player leaderboard there has nothing to rank, so the answer must be a refusal with reason code results_only - not no_data, not out_of_scope, and never a leaderboard with zero or some rows. It must offer the same question without the region, and that question must answer with the independently-derived all-seasons eliminations leader (634 eliminations).
